content: BGG XML API2 /xmlapi2/thing?id=X,Y&type=boardgame&stats=1 supports batch lookup via comma-separated ids. As of July 2, 2025, BGG requires app registration (boardgamegeek.com/applications/create) and a Bearer token Authorization header for all XML API access except downloading one's own collection while logged in -- confirmed live via direct curl returning HTTP 401 with 'WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm=xml api'. Community rate-limit convention is ~2 req/sec (undocumented officially, community consensus).
